reader.requirement: An ACCEPT format 1 with no FROM phrase reads from the implementor's standard device, which this implementation documents as standard input (DOC-A.1-2), the same stream CONSOLE and SYSIN name.
reader.edition-search: BindAccept returns BoundAccept(target, AcceptKind.Device) when acceptSource() is null with no edition test; grep 'Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Construct' in AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs, AcceptSource.cs, ImplementorNames.cs: no hit; VersionConformancePass.VisitAcceptStatement gates only END-ACCEPT and YYYYMMDD/YYYYDDD.
reader.witnesses-cover: all of the rule's range at this edition

probes.printed: A[FIRST     ] B[SECOND    ] C[THIRD     ] (ACCEPT, ACCEPT FROM CONSOLE mnemonic, ACCEPT, one input stream in order); with empty input all three space-filled
probes.expected: the implementor's standard device (standard input, DOC-A.1-2) is used when FROM is omitted

probes.printed: error COBOL0817: ACCEPT FROM 'OUTD': device 'SYSOUT' is not capable of input
probes.expected: §1985:VI.6.5.3 SR1: the mnemonic must be associated with a (input) hardware device; GR5 itself has no refusal half

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR5  (6.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: The default device is standard input, documented as DOC-A.1-2 and read by the same AcceptSource.Device as the CONSOLE/SYSIN mnemonics, so omitted-FROM and FROM-mnemonic ACCEPTs share one stream. The COBOL0817 message cites §2023 clause numbers at --std 85 (a diagnostic-text matter, not GR5). Input runs: compiled with run_probe.py --compile-only, the dll run in that fresh directory with the input redirected.

refuter.evidence: r2sysin-001 at --std 85 (SPECIAL-NAMES SYSIN IS IN-DEV; ACCEPT A1 FROM IN-DEV, ACCEPT B1 with no FROM, ACCEPT C1 FROM IN-DEV; input ONE/TWO/THREE): 'A[ONE   ] B[TWO   ] C[THREE ]': the omitted-FROM ACCEPT reads the same standard-input stream, in order, as the SYSIN mnemonic (the reader tried CONSOLE). DOC-A.1-2 names standard input as the implementor's standard device and AcceptDisplayBinder.BindAccept yields AcceptKind.Device with no edition test. Class c r2nosn-001: 'ACCEPT A1 FROM CONSOLE' with no SPECIAL-NAMES entry is refused at 85 (COBOL0817), so the 1985 path does not take an implementor-name as a FROM operand (§1985:VI.6.5.3 SR1: cite.py 'OK  §1985:VI.6.5.3 SR1 ... the text is in SR1'). cite.py 'OK  §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR5  (6.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5' for 'the device that the implementor specifies as standard is used'. GR5 itself has no refusal half and no edition arm; the size defect found under GR4 (binary receivers) is GR4's, not GR5's. COBOL0817's text cites §2023 clause numbers at --std 85, a message matter.
